description: The Rosengarten is the public garden above Bern’s old town, with lawns, late roses, and a view across the Aare bend to the minster and the roofs. September is past the main rose flush, so the beds are mixed bloom and spent flowers rather than a June display. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and mild, about 17°C, with a light breeze and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
